title: Dakyworld Website Screenshot
description: One stable contract. Everything the caller needs and nothing shaped by any particular actor's habits.

urls.title: Pages
urls.description: The pages to photograph, each with the caller's own id. The id comes back on the matching result row unchanged, which is how a picture is matched to the business that asked for it. A page may also carry its own `viewport` and `maxHeight`, overriding the run's — that is what lets one run take the laptop picture and the phone picture of the same homepage instead of paying for two boots. A bare string is accepted when running this by hand, and is given a positional id.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.description: The browser window. A real device size: 1280x800 is a laptop, 390x844 is an iPhone 14. It is not a crop — it is what the page thinks it is being viewed on, which decides where a sticky header sits and how much a lazy-loading gallery brings in before the shutter.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page rather than one window. Use `maxHeight` to keep only the top of it.

delay.title: Delay after load (ms)
delay.description: How long to wait after the page has loaded, for fonts and a hero image to arrive.

maxWidth.title: Maximum width (px)
maxWidth.description: Resize the finished picture down to this width. Never up. Leave blank to keep the captured width.

maxHeight.title: Maximum height (px)
maxHeight.description: Keep this many rows from the top and throw the rest away. Measured in captured pixels, before the resize. Leave blank to keep the whole capture.

navigationTimeoutMs.title: Page timeout (ms)
navigationTimeoutMs.description: How long one page may take before it is written off as a timeout. One broken website cannot hold the batch open.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Apify proxy settings. The proxy is forced on whatever is set here — a datacentre IP with no proxy in front of it is refused by a good share of small-business sites behind Cloudflare — so this only chooses the groups and the country.
